```{r sanity check: total number of events, eval=FALSE}
  urevent_256[[sub2]] = df

         sum(list.files(urevent_1024_dir)==list.files(urevent_256_dir)) == length(list.files(urevent_256_dir)),

# continue with checking actual dfs
```

```{r clean events}

# SPECIAL NOTE:
# sub24 recorded "flushing" trig codes (1,2,4,8,16 etc), real data starts 185th row [everything before is marked as invalid]
# sub66 missing 1 trial in true_feed block 1 (trial 83, skipped in this data) due to pause/unpause [BUT I HIT PAUSE ON EEG RECORDING WHICH IS WHY THE EVENTS THEMSELVES ARE MISSING AND RESP RT WAS INCORRECT]

urevents_clean_dflist = NULL

for (s in 1:nrow(subinfo)) {
  
  curr_sub = subinfo$subID[s]
  #curr_sub = "sub66"
  
  # subinfo for task cond 
  this_sub_info = subinfo %>% filter(subID == curr_sub) %>% select(-session_time)
  
  # load events
  path_all_events   = paste0(urevent_256_dir,curr_sub,"_urevent.csv")

  #events = read.csv(path_clean_events) %>% 
  #  mutate(subID = curr_sub)
  
  # -2048 to convert to actual trig code values
  # do not filter OUT invalid codes yet 
  urevents_raw = read.csv(path_all_events) %>% 
    mutate(subID = curr_sub,
           urevent = 1:nrow(.),
           latency_s = round((latency-1)/256,1),
           type = type-2048#,
           #type = as.character(type)
    ) 
  
  #urevents_raw %>% filter(type %nin% valid_codes$trig_code)  # check for invalid codes
  
  urevents =
    # get trig code info
    merge(urevents_raw, valid_codes, by.x="type", by.y="trig_code", all.x=TRUE) %>% 
    arrange(urevent) 
  
  # mark i_trial using study_stim / test_stim as benchmark
  i_trial = 0
  i_trial_study <- i_trial_test <- 1
  i=0
  for (i in 1:nrow(urevents)) {
    
    # mark invalid rows
    if (urevents$type[i] %nin% valid_codes$trig_code) {
      urevents$trig_type[i] = "invalid"
      urevents$task[i] = ""
      urevents$epoch_type[i] = "invalid"
    } else if (curr_sub == "sub20" & i < 86) {
      # special treatment for subj who had flushing codes recorded
      urevents$trig_type[i] = "invalid"
      urevents$task[i] = ""
      urevents$epoch_type[i] = "invalid"
    } else if (curr_sub == "sub23" & i < 126) {
      urevents$trig_type[i] = "invalid"
      urevents$task[i] = ""
      urevents$epoch_type[i] = "invalid"
    } else if (curr_sub == "sub24" & i < 185) {
      urevents$trig_type[i] = "invalid"
      urevents$task[i] = ""
      urevents$epoch_type[i] = "invalid"
    } else if (curr_sub == "sub25" & i < 135) {
      urevents$trig_type[i] = "invalid"
      urevents$task[i] = ""
      urevents$epoch_type[i] = "invalid"
    } else if (curr_sub == "sub26" & i < 87) {
      urevents$trig_type[i] = "invalid"
      urevents$task[i] = ""
      urevents$epoch_type[i] = "invalid"
    }
    
    # fix missing 99[space]
    if (i>1 & urevents$trig_type[i] == "ins_text_stim") {
      if (urevents$trig_type[i-1] == "ins_text_stim") {
        urevents$trig_type[i] = "space"
        urevents$type[i] = 99
      }
    }
    
    # get trial number using benchmark events (stim onset)
    if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "study_stim") {
      i_trial = i_trial_study
      i_trial_study = i_trial_study + 1  # ready for next trial
      # reset to 1 if after end of list
      if (urevents$task[i] == "practice" & i_trial_study == 6) {
        i_trial_study = 1
      } else if (urevents$task[i] %in% c("true_feed","strategic","false_feed") & i_trial_study == 101) {
        i_trial_study = 1
      }
    } else if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "test_stim") {
      i_trial = i_trial_test 
      i_trial_test = i_trial_test + 1
      if (urevents$task[i] == "practice" & i_trial_test == 11) {
        i_trial_test = 1  # reset to 1 after prac
      } else if (curr_sub == "sub66" & urevents$task[i] == "true_feed" & i_trial_test == 83) {
        i_trial_test = 84 # sub66 true_feed test1 REMOVE TRIAL 83-84 IN ANALYSIS [paused+unpaused to switch out battery]
        # RESP MATCHES 84; both 83 and 84 stim are OLD
      } else if (urevents$task[i] %in% c("true_feed","strategic","false_feed") & i_trial_test == 201) {
        i_trial_test = 1  # reset to 1 after real test
      }
    } else {
      i_trial = NA
    }
    
    urevents$i_trial[i] = i_trial
    
    # mark test block 1 vs 2
    if (urevents$task[i] != "practice" & urevents$epoch_type[i] == "test_stim" & urevents$i_trial[i] <= 100) {
      urevents$test_block[i] = 1
    } else if (urevents$task[i] != "practice" & urevents$epoch_type[i] == "test_stim" & urevents$i_trial[i] > 100) {
      urevents$test_block[i] = 2
    } else {
      urevents$test_block[i] = NA
    }
    
    if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "test_stim" & urevents$i_trial[i]>100) {
      if (urevents$trig_type[i-3]=="ins_text_stim") {
        urevents$test_block[i] = 2
      }
    }
    
    # repeat trial info [i_trial, task, test_block] for surrounding events:
    # study: i-2 = blank, i-1 = fixcross, i = stim
    # test: i-2=blank, i-1=fixcross, i=stim, i+1=resp, blank [NO TRIGGER SENT], i+2=feed, i+3=blank
    
    if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "study_stim") {
      urevents$i_trial[i-2] <- urevents$i_trial[i-1] <- i_trial
      urevents$task[i-2]    <- urevents$task[i-1]    <- urevents$task[i]
      # no test_block
    } else if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "test_stim") {
      # i cannot modify future rows so i- and i+ need to be done separately
      urevents$i_trial[i-2] <- urevents$i_trial[i-1] <- i_trial
      urevents$task[i-2]    <- urevents$task[i-1]    <- urevents$task[i]
      urevents$test_block[i-2] <- urevents$test_block[i-1] <- urevents$test_block[i]
      # handling resp and feed separately also fixes missing resp trig (sometimes a trial has 6 trig [missing resp.key] instead of 5)
    } else if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "resp") {
      # stim+1
      urevents$i_trial[i]    <- urevents$i_trial[i-1]
      urevents$task[i]       <- urevents$task[i-1]
      urevents$test_block[i] <- urevents$test_block[i-1]
    } else if (urevents$epoch_type[i] == "feed") {
      # stim+2
      urevents$i_trial[i]    <- urevents$i_trial[i-2]
      urevents$task[i]       <- urevents$task[i-2]
      urevents$test_block[i] <- urevents$test_block[i-2]
    } else if (i>=2 & urevents$trig_type[i] == "blank_onset") {
      # stim+3
      # get the blank AFTER feed 
      # can handle missing resp because there are enough events in the same trial before resp [e.g. if missing a resp, i-3 will reach fixcross instead of test_stim]
      if (urevents$epoch_type[i-1] == "feed") {
        urevents$i_trial[i]    <- urevents$i_trial[i-3]
        urevents$task[i]       <- urevents$task[i-3]
        urevents$test_block[i] <- urevents$test_block[i-3]
      }
      
    }
    
  }
  
  # mark test cond using subinfo 
  urevents_fixed = urevents %>% 
    merge(this_sub_info, all.x=TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(durr = latency_s - dplyr::lag(latency_s,1),
           resp_rt = case_when(epoch_type=="resp" ~ latency_s - dplyr::lag(latency_s))) %>% 
    mutate(test_cond = case_when(task=="strategic"  & !is.na(test_block) & i_trial <=100 ~ strategic_cond_1,
                                 task=="strategic"  & !is.na(test_block) & i_trial >=101 ~ strategic_cond_2,
                                 task=="false_feed" & !is.na(test_block) & i_trial <=100 ~ false_feed_cond_1,
                                 task=="false_feed" & !is.na(test_block) & i_trial >=101 ~ false_feed_cond_2)
    )  %>% 
    select(-c(task_0,task_1,task_2,strategic_cond_1,strategic_cond_2,false_feed_cond_1,false_feed_cond_2)) %>% 
    relocate(c(i_trial,test_cond,test_block),.after=epoch_type)
  
  # put in dflist 
  urevents_clean_dflist[[s]] = urevents_fixed
  names(urevents_clean_dflist)[s] = curr_sub
  
  # write individual csv
  write.csv(urevents_fixed, paste0(clean_urevent_dir,curr_sub,"_urevent.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
  
  message(curr_sub)
  
}


length(urevents_clean_dflist)

```

```{r sanity check: i_trial, eval=FALSE}
n_check_i_trial = 0   # total number of subs

  }

    count(task,i_trial) %>% count(task)
  #check_i_trial = df %>% filter(epoch_type=="test_stim", task!="practice") %>%  
  #  count(task,i_trial) %>% count(task)
```

```{r import trial info}
clean_urevent_dir
trials_dir

clean_urevent_list = list.files(clean_urevent_dir)
trials_list = list.files(trials_dir)
# these two do not (should not) have the same length

urevents_complete_dir = "/Volumes/toshiba/eeg_data_backup/01_urevent_complete/"

urevents_with_trial_info = NULL

new_eeg_sub_list = c("sub78","sub79")   # UPDATE NEW SUBS

for (u in 1:length(clean_urevent_list)) {
  # ONLY include valid eeg sub
  
  eeg_sub = str_remove(clean_urevent_list[u],"_urevent.csv")  
  #eeg_sub = "sub71"
  if (eeg_sub %nin% new_eeg_sub_list) {
    next
  }

  # load fixed urevents
  urevents_path = paste0(clean_urevent_dir,clean_urevent_list[u])
  
  urevents_fixed_loaded = read.csv(urevents_path) %>% 
    unite(mergeID,c(subID,task,test_block,i_trial),sep=" ",remove=FALSE,na.rm=TRUE) %>% 
    # remove=F: do not remove original cols
    # na.rm=T:  do not paste NAs into new string
    mutate(mergeID = case_when(task %nin% c("true_feed","strategic","false_feed") | is.na(test_block) ~ NA,
                               TRUE ~ mergeID))
  
  total_events = nrow(urevents_fixed_loaded)
  
  # find trial info to load for subID in the list
  for (t in 1:length(trials_list)) {
    trials_path = paste0(trials_dir,trials_list[t])
    
    if (str_detect(trials_path, "NO_EEG")) {
      next  # skip if no eeg data
    }
    
    beh_sub = str_remove(trials_list[t],"_trials.csv") 
    
    if (nchar(beh_sub) != 5) {
      stop("CHECK TRIALS FILE NAME")  # check if file name is not in subxx format 
    }
    
    if (beh_sub == eeg_sub) {
      
      message(paste0("MERGING ",eeg_sub, " ",beh_sub))
      
      beh_trials = read.csv(trials_path) %>% 
        mutate(subID = beh_sub) %>% 
        rename(task=curr_task) %>% 
        select(-c(participant,img_start,img_end,stim,stim_img,matches("keys"))) %>% 
        unite(mergeID,c(subID,task,test_block,i_trial),sep=" ",remove=FALSE,na.rm=TRUE) 
      
      if ("X" %in% c(names(beh_trials))) {
        beh_trials = beh_trials %>% select(-contains("X"))
      }
      
      urevents_complete = merge(urevents_fixed_loaded,beh_trials, 
                                all.x=TRUE   # KEEP ALL UREVENTS!!!
                                ) %>% 
        arrange(urevent) %>% 
        select(-mergeID) %>% 
        # mark potential boundary points 
        mutate(boundary_time = case_when(i_trial==1   & epoch_type=="study_stim" ~ latency_s - 0.5,  # study start
                                         i_trial==1   & epoch_type=="test_stim"  ~ latency_s - 0.5,  # test block 1 start
                                         i_trial==101 & epoch_type=="test_stim"  ~ latency_s - 0.5,  # test block 2 start
                                         
                                         i_trial==100 & epoch_type=="study_stim" ~ latency_s + 0.2,   # study end
                                         i_trial==100 & epoch_type=="feed" ~ latency_s + 0.5,        # test block 1 end
                                         i_trial==200 & epoch_type=="feed" ~ latency_s + 0.5,        # test block 2 end
                                         
                                         TRUE ~ NA)) %>% 
        mutate(boundary_time = ifelse(task=="practice", NA, boundary_time)) %>% 
        select(subID,type,urevent,trig_type,epoch_type,task,test_block,test_cond,i_trial,
               latency,latency_s,boundary_time,everything())    # reorder cols
      
      
      if (nrow(urevents_complete) != total_events) {
        stop("NUMBER OF EVENTS DOES NOT MATCH")
      }
    }
    
  }
  
  urevents_with_trial_info[[u]] = urevents_complete
  names(urevents_with_trial_info)[u] = eeg_sub
  
  # export
  write.csv(urevents_complete,paste0(urevents_complete_dir,eeg_sub,"_urevent_complete.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
  
}

length(urevents_with_trial_info)
urevents_complete %>% count(epoch_type,boundary_time)
```
